description: Injects the main-conversation operating rules at the start of any session opened inside a git repository, and warns when the memory-file import that delivers the rest is missing or stale. A second hook checks comment blocks as they are written against the budget in the working agreements. Those two emit context only; neither returns a permission decision. A third hook locks test files that were written in the session and then seen failing, and asks before an edit changes their existing lines; it returns only ask. Set PLAN_FLOW_COMMENT_BUDGET=off to silence the comment check on its own, and PLAN_FLOW_TEST_LOCK=off to silence the test lock.
